subject: Renewal governance: onboarding buffer & approval ladder
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: tessa_morgan, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Akash Patel <akash.patel@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + onboarding refresh — capacity buffer request

Hi Tessa and Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're starting our internal renewal cadence for our Redwood subscription and wanted to align on two things before we loop procurement in:

1) Evidence refresh — our security team needs an updated vendor evidence packet (SOC2 excerpts, data retention policy, and access matrix). Can you confirm what version you can share?
2) Commit buffer — traffic looks spiky for Q3; we'd like to discuss adding a +30% commit buffer for the renewal term and understand how that maps to billing and PO language.

Timeline: procurement wants to start official review on May 18 — can we have the evidence packet and a short mutual action plan by EOD May 11?

Attachments: Q1_usage_export.csv (for our reference)

Appreciate it — if it's easier, we can do a 20-minute call early next week.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of IT Procurement
Nimbus Analytics

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + onboarding refresh — capacity buffer request

Lena — thanks for the clear asks. Quick plan from our side: 

- Evidence packet: I'll pull the latest vendor pack (includes SOC2 summary, retention PDFs, access matrix) and confirm redactions. Expect a draft by Tue, May 11 EOD.
- Capacity buffer: happy to draft an amendment that adds a +30% soft buffer and spells out billing behavior when the buffer is consumed. That usually takes a short SOW addendum and procurement PO.
- MAP: Karthik will put together a mutual action plan with milestones for procurement intake, legal review, and PO issuance.

Cc'ing Stephanie (CS Ops) to flag internal procurement portal steps and Markus (Finance) and Laura (Legal) to expedite PO and SOW review lanes.

If procurement needs an expedited lane, mark that in the MAP and we can propose a hard cutoff for signatures.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbus-analytics.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + procurement link

Hi Lena / team — attaching a short MAP and the proposed SOW amendment to capture the +30% buffer. High-level milestones below: 

1) May 11 — Redwood provides evidence packet (deliverable: vendor_evidence_v2.pdf)
2) May 12–14 — Nimbus procurement reviews; submit portal intake form
3) May 15 — Redwood provides SOW amendment draft (SOW_Amendment_v1.docx)
4) May 18 — Nimbus issues PO / finance approval (target)

Procurement portal: https://procurement.nimbus-analytics.com/intake?ref=redwood
Note on billing: buffer is treated as reserved headroom. If consumed, overage invoices are issued monthly; SOW addendum contains sample language.

Attachments: SOW_Amendment_v1.docx (draft), MAP_Renewal_Nimbus_48321.pdf

Let us know if you want a 20-minute sync on May 12 to walk procurement through the portal form.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions & Renewals | Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Akash Patel <akash.patel@nimbus-analytics.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement link

Thanks Karthik — this MAP looks good. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Evidence packet: important that the access matrix includes role-to-role mappings (not just groups) — can your evidence packet include that granularity?
- Portal intake: we will complete the intake on May 12; if we mark this as "expedite", can Redwood guarantee SOW review in 48 hours? Our legal needs to see redlines quickly.

If you can confirm expedited SOW review SLA we will mark expedite. Otherwise we'll follow standard cadence.

Cheers,
Lena

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement link

Lena — confirmed on both counts:

- Evidence packet: we'll include role-to-role mappings in vendor_evidence_v2.pdf and flag any fields we need to redact for customer-facing distribution.
- Expedited review: Laura (Legal) has agreed to a 48-hour turnaround for redlines if Nimbus marks the intake as "expedite" and our finance team has PO approval on file. Markus, can you confirm internal sign-off timeline?

Next steps (final):
- May 11 EOD: Redwood sends vendor_evidence_v2.pdf to Lena (attached).
- May 12: Nimbus completes procurement portal intake and marks expedite.
- May 13: Redwood legal provides redlines to SOW_Amendment_v1.docx (48-hr SLA).
- May 18: Target PO issuance.

Attachments: vendor_evidence_v2.pdf

Thanks everyone — I will monitor the portal intake and trigger the fast-lane if we see the expedite flag come through.

— Tessa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
